[1] You can't really fight early game as much.
[1] So like for example, against Jax, you need your Q stacks, you need to hold them at all times, and that just allows you to play the lane without getting all in.

[1] Level six, you unlock your old, which is pretty strong in 1v1s, especially if you get a level up timer on them where you're level six and they're not. That's going to be your best timer to all-in.
[1] For your overall plan for top lane, you pretty much just want to play safe in lane.
[1] And just try to keep your wave frozen close to your tower. That's Gwen's best spot to play in because you can queue them and most melee champs you will outrange with your Q.
[1] But ideally, you're literally just going to be farming, side laning, never really group until two to three items at the very least.
